Section One
-----------

Euler's identity is \(e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0\), a famous inline equation.

Displayed separately:

\[
\int_0^\infty e^{-x^2}\,dx = \frac{\sqrt{\pi}}{2}
\]

A footnote reference follows.^[This is a Pandoc-style inline footnote.]
